newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's BEX to be withdrawn from public listing.
newsitem.headline: Spain's BEX to be withdrawn from public listing.

text.p: The board of directors of Spain's Banco Exterior de Espana said on Monday it will offer to buy shareholders' stock in order to withdraw it from public listing.
A note explained that the public bid will affect only the 0.74 percent of capital held by around 6,200 shareholders.
The remaining 99.26 percent of Banco de Exterior capital is in the hands of Corporacion Bancaria de Espana (Argentaria).
The proposal has to be approved by the stock exchange commission CNMV, which is expected to fix the price.
The price will be fixed between 2,800 and 2,850 pesetas, which is its average price during the last six months.
The move should also be approved by a shareholders' meeting, scheduled on February 28.
